title: F1s′ components on the four Evaluation lists: XALL bridge (4 streams), v11 T3 head (2 streams), 7 conditions
role: Extracts the frozen features of train + the four lists (ImageBind face / voice, FaRL ep16 and ep64, CLIP, CLIP ViT-L/14, SimAM-ResNet100 VoxBlink2 and its VoxCeleb2 fine-tune, ViT age, wav2vec2 age / gender, AdaFace, ArcFace, SpeechBrain ECAPA, AudioCLIP), scores the saved XALL bridge s007_xall.pt (5 nets, CLEANCOMP-01 final; picked over best-v7 by XALL_PREFER) and the saved v11 T3 head v11_t3head.pt (reused, not retrained), fits the face-gender logistic model on 23 018 train faces inside the run (condition pf_m), and writes e2e_eval/components_eval.npz: b3 = XALL_deep0, XALL_cca, XALL_ib, XALL_age (+ rel, relg = 0 under NOREL), t3 = anP512_deep, anP512_cca (+ t3_relg = 0), co = is_en, pf_m, pv_m, gdiff, agef, agev, agegap, pid, and the face_farl16 / voice_sam100p / voice_sam100f arrays of the CA head; forwards the SAFE-04 tables (e2e_eval/safe04/, copied from cleancomp-e2e) on which e112f1sx refits the F1s′ fuser. Level-0 self-test <= 7.2e-7 (submission/checks.json).

runner_requirements.why: The v11 T3 head job (HEAD_B64 decoded to lab/, run as head_entry.py) finds lid_strict.json through a literal Path('/kaggle/input').rglob fallback (Experiment/T3ENC-01/run.py strict_drop, kaggle/build_l0_notebooks.py line 143): v11_head/job.log of the run reads 'LID_STRICT MAV voice files dropped from training rows: 58 of 58 listed | /kaggle/input/datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-lid-strict-p/lid_strict.json'. Code decoded at run time from a base64 zip is written to disk and imported; the runner's replacement of the string '/kaggle/input' in the stage code does not reach it. The literal path /kaggle/input must therefore show exactly this stage's inputs while the stage runs: e.g. a container with the virtual input mounted at /kaggle/input (as release/docker/ff.py does), or a symlink /kaggle/input -> the virtual input on a Linux host without /kaggle. In a Kaggle notebook whose own /kaggle/input holds other attachments, run this stage in a session with exactly its inputs attached (as the original run).
runner_requirements.kaggle: separate session with exactly these inputs
